title: Message and call on your own
drDigitalIntro:
This is your assessment for this unit. There are no step-by-step instructions this time — just a list of things to accomplish.

- At first nothing glows — you decide where to click. If you get really stuck, the yellow rings switch on and lead you to the finish.
- You can do the objectives in any order.
- Open the objectives list with the small arrow in the dark bar to see what is left.
- If you get stuck, the Hint button gives you a nudge — not the answer.

Different people from the ones in the lessons — read each objective for who it means.

playgroundTask.goal: You messaged and called without instructions
playgroundTask.hint: The + beside Contacts starts something new. A reaction needs a double-click or a press-and-hold on the other person's message, never a single click. Call controls appear once a call is running.

steps.say: Put Grandma in the group too.
React to a message somebody sent you.
Mute your microphone during the call.

drDigitalSuccess: Group chats, photos, reactions, and a video call — all of it sequenced by you. That is everything this unit taught.
drDigitalHint: The + at the top of the contact list starts a group. To react, press and hold on the other person's bubble. To send a photo, use the + next to the message box.
